rubrics.criterion: The end-of-run digest mail family is fully retired: the run-summary data type and its fixed-format rendering in the notification model package, the digest title template parsing helper and the context type it renders against in the message-templating package, and the body/subject assembly helpers in the mail notifier are all absent from the final tree.
rubrics.rationale: This family is the centerpiece residue of the mail-transport and templating swaps and spans three packages; grading must confirm the whole pipeline is gone rather than only its entry helper.

rubrics.criterion: The legacy manifest re-keying family is fully retired: the one-off exported re-keying routine, the flat pre-tag-key entry layout type, and the missing-value defaulting and key-construction methods that exist only for that routine are absent, while the versioned migration chain (the numbered migrations and the version metadata bookkeeping that drive them) is left intact and still applied at startup.
rubrics.rationale: This family is the storage-side residue superseded by the versioned chain; the criterion separately pins the superseding mechanism so a solver cannot gut the sanctioned migration path while cleaning the leftover.

rubrics.criterion: The artifact-suffix tag filter family is absent from the public registry client, with tag listing and tag sorting behavior unchanged.
rubrics.rationale: The registry client is where the artifact-tag-skip residue lives; the criterion ties the removal to the preservation of the live tag API right next to it.

rubrics.criterion: The signal-based stop family in the application package — the channel-draining stop helper and its signal-reason mapping helper — is absent, and shutdown still works through the existing context-cancellation path.
rubrics.rationale: This is the run-lifecycle residue of the shutdown simplification; the criterion requires the removed variant to be gone together with its pure helper, not to be replaced by a new stop path.

rubrics.criterion: No retired family is kept in the tree by inventing new reachability: the repair does not add calls to the removed helpers from the run loop, the notifier send path, startup, or any other live site, and does not register them anywhere they could be invoked from.
rubrics.rationale: For this smell, deleting versus wiring back in are both ways to make a reachability concern disappear, but only deletion matches the requested outcome; a grader must reject resuscitation as a resolution.

rubrics.criterion: Removal is judged per family across all four audited areas, not by a shared naming pattern: the final tree shows no leftover member of any retired family in the application, notification, storage or registry areas.
rubrics.rationale: The residue deliberately avoids a common marker; a name-fragment sweep covers only part of it. The criterion enforces the semantic family boundary across all areas at once.

rubrics.criterion: Every file touched by the removals ends with the smallest import set its remaining declarations need: no import remains that only served removed declarations, and no new dependency is introduced.
rubrics.rationale: The residue families were injected together with the imports they require; complete retirement includes that vestige, and this criterion is answerable by comparing import blocks in the solver patch.

rubrics.criterion: The removals stay contained to the production files of the audited areas: no test source is edited and no live call site outside the retired families is adjusted, so the change demonstrates the families were genuinely unreferenced rather than disconnected by force.
rubrics.rationale: In this repository the retired families are verifiable precisely because nothing in the suite or the live code mentions them; a solver who finds itself adjusting tests or live call sites to make a deletion compile has mislabeled something live as dead.

rubrics.criterion: The digest title template constant in the message-templating package is removed together with the pipeline that consumed it, even though no function references force its removal.
rubrics.rationale: This orphan constant is deliberately invisible to name-reference reasoning; requiring its cleanup grades whether the solver understood the family as a semantic unit rather than chasing identifier references.

rubrics.criterion: After the repair, the audited areas contain no orphaned artifact of any retired family: no dangling references to removed identifiers in source or tests, no second-phase helper that only consumed them, and no comment blocks documenting symbols that no longer exist.
rubrics.rationale: The focus of this smell is complete removal without leftovers; this criterion grades the diff for residue the family deletions themselves do not cover.

rubrics.criterion: No live per-entry notification machinery is removed or altered: the message construction from the configured template title/body, the shared template function set used by it, every configured notifier including the go-mail based mail send path with its secret retrieval, and the dispatch that constructs notifiers remain in place and are still invoked from their existing call sites.
rubrics.rationale: The retired summary mail and the live per-entry templating live in the same three packages and share idiom; the most plausible real failure is confusing one for the other, so preservation of exactly this machinery is graded.

rubrics.criterion: The runtime behavior outside the removed families is untouched: scheduled and startup runs still analyze images through the provider set and worker pool and print the closing per-status counters; the database still opens, migrates and reads/writes manifest entries under the current name-plus-tag keys; tag listing and sorting produce identical results; shutdown, gRPC health status handling and metrics recording are unchanged.
rubrics.rationale: The removal sites sit in files that also own these live behaviors; the criterion enumerates the instance's concrete behavioral contracts so a solver cannot simplify away live mechanisms adjacent to residue.

rubrics.criterion: The exported surface of the public packages (the registry client and the generated protobuf code) is unchanged by the repair, and no pre-existing internal declaration disappears other than the retired families the audit targeted.
rubrics.rationale: The public packages are imported by outside consumers, and the residue includes exported internals; the criterion separates sanctioned removals from collateral ones.
